body:
A) 5 each (10 a day)
B) 10 each (20 a day) (my pick)
C) 20 each (40 a day)
Each player collects eggs and milk once per game day, so up to 4 times a real hour.
Only farm eggs and milk can be sold. The Market still sells eggs and milk for 6, so nobody can buy cheap and sell dear.
Compare: mailbox 10-20 a day, litter 30 a day, a job day about 290.
The game has no selling yet: a Sell button at the Market, farm goods only.

comments.text: Approved: you decided it in chat (31 Oct): B, 10 each.

short: Market pays 10 each for farm eggs and milk
